title: Wall Mount Shower Squeegee 15-Inch Solid Brass With Hook | Golden Yellow | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Shower Squeegee 15-Inch | Allied Brass, Golden Yellow
description:
Keep shower doors, tile, and mirrors clearer with quick, easy strokes using this wall mount shower squeegee crafted from solid brass in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality.

Highlights:
- Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Replaceable blade for easy upkeep
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Corrosion-free and rust-free performance from the designer finish

Specs:
- Category: Squeegee
- Overall size: 10-Inch L x 10-Inch W x 15-Inch H
- Projection: 3-Inch
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 3.2 lb
- Included: Squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Style notes: Complements traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories; ideal for coordinating with heritage bathroom fixtures.
